source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I’ve deployed fixes to production just now that prevent incorrect “Mint Successful” modals and make the approval -> mint flow work properly.

Updates made:

[ACCOUNT_001] Success modal gating: The modal now appears only if the mint transaction receipt corresponds to the current mint hash and has not previously been displayed. Entering or removing referral codes will no longer cause the success popup to appear.
[ACCOUNT_001] Reset on new mint attempt: Clicking mint now clears the previous success state, pending params, and tracking refs, preventing stale success states from carrying over into a new attempt.
[ACCOUNT_001] USDC auto-mint after approval: I removed the outdated success guard, so minting starts immediately once approval finishes rather than reporting approval-only success.
[ACCOUNT_001] ETH amount and buffer: Dynamic ETH pricing continues to select the higher value between the live price and the contract min (0.0055 ETH), including the buffer. This remains unchanged from the previous hotfix.

Please perform a hard refresh (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R), then test again:
[ACCOUNT_001] USDC: approve -> mint should start automatically, and the success modal should appear only after the mint tx is confirmed.
[ACCOUNT_001] ETH: a failed tx should not display a success modal; it will be triggered only by genuine mint receipts.

If any additional problems occur, send me the latest tx hashes and I’ll inspect them immediately.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports deploying a production fix that starts the USDC mint immediately after approval and tracks the mint receipt.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
Findings
The ETH mint reverted (0x3af7…0855c on Base) because the on-chain swap router is configured as 0x2626…e481, which is not the Uniswap V3 SwapRouter. The contract invokes exactInputSingle at that address, causing a revert, so all ETH mints will fail until the router is fixed on-chain.

The USDC mint works;
- token #1 exists and belongs to 0x3b55868Dd2ebA28f97b3dB55a4cB706a078154B5. Its metadata and assets resolve successfully:
- Metadata: [URL_024]
- Image: [URL_025]

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports on-chain confirmation that the USDC mint succeeded, token #1 exists and belongs to the buyer address, and its metadata and assets resolve.

source_message.text:
